reviews.title: A great standing desk.  I am very happy with this purchase.
reviews.comment: This is a great desk!  I have moved into a new place and my old desk was falling apart.  I love to be able to stand while teleworking and wanted a good standing desk. This desk has 4 memory positions.  I have 4 positions set:  sitting, normal standing, rocker board standing, and max height.  The desk is extremely stable at sitting height, and, really, is only slightly less stable at max height. The motors in the legs are very quiet.  The motors function flawlessly and the table raises and lowers very smoothly.  When the desktop is moving, there is no hitching or catching. The cherry laminate desktop is beautiful.  I did find one very slight imperfection on the underside of the desktop but it is hidden and not worth concerning myself or anybody else with.  I could easily fix the flaw with a tiny amount of wood filler. The desk was extremely easy to put together.  The included Allen key is well built and comfortable to hold.  The only other tool I needed, was a phillips screwdriver.  I would definitely recommend building with a second person as the desk is quite heavy when fully assembled. I am very happy with my purchase and will look forward to purchasing more from UPLIFT! Be aware that the table ships in three packages.  I received my first package two days before the others arrived, but this was a FedEx issue, not an UPLIFT issue.  For some reason, FedEx loaded the packages on different trucks and the second truck suffered a mechanical breakdown.
reviews.author: royh

reviews.title: Definitely Worth the Purchase
reviews.comment: I was on the fence about buying a desk for almost $1000, but I'm really glad I made this purchase.  It can be difficult to put together with one person and move it from one place to the other, but this desk is very sturdy and the height adjustment feature works very well.  The motors are decently quiet and have no issues moving up the desk up and down.  After setting the max high and max low limits, I don't have to worry about the desk pulling cables out of the wall by accident.
reviews.author: Rob Fink

reviews.title: Will purchase again IF this ever wears out.
reviews.comment: Solid wood, great finish, multiple compliments when people walk in to my office. This is a great desk if you don't like sitting all day. Ease of use when you want a break, programmable heights make it easy for multiple users if you have a shared desk. Quiet up and down allows no distractions while in a meeting and you have to stand.
reviews.author: Vince M.

reviews.title: Desktop Was Chipped
reviews.comment: This review is solely based on the desktop being chipped.  After putting everything together, I found out a corner of the laminate top missing.  Now I have to take everything apart and figure out how to get this returned.  I'm hoping the return process goes smoothly.
reviews.author: Isaiah

reviews.title: The frames worth the money, tabletops mediocre.
reviews.comment: I tried the Flexispot desk before this one and wasn't happy with the wobble and my knees hit the bar in the middle. This desk has the bar farther back and is much more stable even at max height. No need to get the commercial as the V2 is simply better unless you need the lower height of the commercial. Truly this frame is one of the best you can buy and is worth the premium, the tabletop on the otherhand is overpriced and I wouldn't recommend buying from thier website. In terms of durability from least to most durable it goes Rubberwood > Bamboo > Laminated. I opted for the Laminated and what I do like is that it has pretty drilled holes unlike the flexispot which gets ruined from normal installation. Compared to thier website the value you get with the frame, advanced touchpad, and tabletop is insane, plus the bonus wire holder and rocker board.
reviews.author: Iris Hardig
